name: Idle Dino Farm Tycoon Simulator 3D 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Idle Dino Farm Tycoon Simulator 3D is a casual tycoon game where you helm a prehistoric spectacle, nurturing dinosaurs from hatchlings to colossal wonders. As the park's new manager, your goal is to expand, enthrall visitors, and unveil unique hybrid dinosaurs.
